# Dependencies: every third-party package and why

> **In plain words.** This page lists every outside package Oltrem Mail depends on, the one version it is pinned to (the kit's version of it), which part uses it and why it exists. The kit's own packages are not listed: they come packed from kit/. A new dependency needs a reason and the owner's yes; `pnpm verify` refuses one without a row here, one not pinned in the catalog, and a row nothing uses.

**Where things stand:** 10 tools (used only to build, check or test) and 5 runtime packages (shipped inside a Worker).

| Package | Version | Kind | Used by | Why it exists | Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @changesets/cli | 3.0.3 | tool | oltrem-mail | Versions the modules from a note written with each change, and writes each module's CHANGELOG.md, which oltrem upgrade reads to show a client the notes that apply to it; the kit's own release tool. | the kit plan 14.3 |
| @cloudflare/vitest-plugin | 1.4.5 | tool | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail, oltrem-mail | Runs the test suite inside the Workers runtime, so code that passes in Node and fails in a Worker is caught; it also applies the D1 migrations to the test database. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| @cloudflare/workers-types | 5.20261019.1 | tool | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail, oltrem-mail | The types of the Workers runtime bindings (D1, KV, queues) for the type check. | the kit plan 4.2 |
| @eslint/js | 10.0.1 | tool | oltrem-mail | ESLint's own recommended rules for the plain JavaScript scripts of the verify chain. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| @types/node | 22.20.5 | tool | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail | The types of Node's own modules for the modules' pages, which are type-checked against the DOM and Node rather than the Workers runtime, and for the test configurations. | the kit plan 15.3 |
| dompurify | 3.4.17 | runtime | @oltrem/mail | Cleans a received message's HTML on the phone before the inbox's reading frame shows it: every link forced to a new tab, forms and their controls taken out, remote images held back until Show images. Shipped only in the inbox's reader script, never in the Worker. | Oltrem Mail docs/inbox.md section 4, approved by the owner 2026-11-02 |
| eslint | 10.13.0 | tool | oltrem-mail | The linter. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| lucide-preact | 1.60.0 | runtime | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail | The one icon set of the primitives (status pills, empty states, buttons): one icon is under 2 KB, and islands import only the icons they use. | the kit plan 12.4 |
| postal-mime | 4.2.0 | runtime | @oltrem/mail | Reads a received message: on arrival in the Worker, its first 128 KB (headers, snippet, search text, attachment names); on the phone, the stored copy the person opens, with its attachments. No dependencies of its own, made for Workers. | Oltrem Mail docs/inbox.md sections 1 and 3, approved by the owner 2026-11-02 |
| preact | 11.0.1 | runtime | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail | The island renderer of every screen (the owner's choice, card 9); the primitives are Preact components. The 11.x line, which every library the kit uses declares support for. | the kit plan 12.1 |
| prettier | 3.9.10 | tool | oltrem-mail | One formatting for every code file, so agents never argue about style and diffs show only meaning. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| typescript | 5.9.3 | tool | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail, oltrem-mail | The type check. Pinned to the 5.x line until the linter's TypeScript support covers the next major version. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| typescript-eslint | 8.72.0 | tool | oltrem-mail | ESLint's TypeScript parser and recommended rules. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| vitest | 4.1.12 | tool | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail, oltrem-mail | The test runner for packages and modules; the Workers pool plugs into it. | the kit plan 15.6 |
| zod | 4.6.7 | runtime | @oltrem/campaigns, @oltrem/email, @oltrem/mail | Validates the body or query of every email and campaigns route, as the kit's other modules do (the Mini build, a few kilobytes). | the kit plan 5.3 |
